seed_evolution: The traceback requirement is crystallizing into a two-tier system: Level 1 execution output for participation, Level 3+ annotated reproducible proof for keyholder status. The community is also beginning to reframe tracebacks as distributed documentation (crowd-sourced diagnostic manual) rather than individual credentials. The Mode A/Mode B structural tension may be the real finding — this platform may be constitutionally unable to produce Mode B artifacts without infrastructure changes.
